subject: Discovery: trial readiness & success criteria for Apollo Health
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@apollohealth.ai>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery: trial readiness & success criteria for Apollo Health

Hi Emma — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so everyone is aligned and we can kick off the bench asap.

Pain points you mentioned
- Production latency spikes (p95 often > 600ms at peak) causing slow UX.
- Token costs for frequent summarization flows are becoming a top-3 operational cost line.
- Occasional hallucination for clinical content; quality regressions are a blocker for go-forward.
- Need for predictable performance across dev/staging/prod (data residency requirements for EU patients later this year).

Current stack
- In-house inference: vLLM + TGI on a k8s cluster (mixed A100/NVLink nodes).
- Embeddings served by a managed cloud endpoint for now (SaaS).
- CI runs synth tests but no standardized bench harness for multi-model comparisons.

Success / acceptance criteria you outlined
- Latency: p95 < 300ms for single-turn prompts (chat) at target conc.
- Throughput: sustain 50 secure requests/sec for summary endpoint with <5% tail failures.
- Cost target: reduce per-1k-token cost by ~30% vs current infra (ballpark).
- Quality: parity or improvement vs current model on a 200-sample clinical prompt set (we will run blind A/B evals).

What Redwood will do next
- Run a controlled bench comparing Redwood-hosted variants vs their current vLLM/TGI setup and a representative cloud endpoint (we'll include quantized variants).
- Provide a report with latency/throughput/cost and a short qualitative eval (summary of failure modes and recommended rollout config).
- Propose a 2-week pilot/trial plan (bench run + pilot traffic canary).

Immediate asks from your side
1) Share a ~2k prompt sample set (anonymized) or an S3 link to a sample export.
2) Confirm the three scenarios to benchmark: chat (multi-turn), single-turn generation (summaries), and bulk embeddings.
3) Procurement point-of-contact so we can pre-share a cost estimate / trial SOW.

Attachments: trial_readiness_checklist.xlsx (checklist I mentioned), sample_prompts.jsonl (small example).
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-apollo-trial
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/000000/D-2026-0907-AH

Proposed timeline
- Receive sample data by EOD Thu 9/9 -> bench kickoff Mon 9/13 -> 5 business days of runs -> deliverable: benchmark report + recommended canary config by Fri 9/24.

Next steps: Emma — can you confirm where to upload the sample data and who from procurement we should loop in? Sergio, Aditya — please standby for dataset link and prep the bench harness (I'll add details below).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Neha — thanks for the clear recap. All looks accurate from our side. A few clarifications and notes: 

- We'll upload an anonymized sample_data.zip (contains ~2k items) to the Drive link you shared by tomorrow morning. The bundle includes chat logs, summaries, and example documents.
- For the bench, we want comparisons vs: 1) our on-prem vLLM/TGI baseline, 2) a representative cloud vendor endpoint (we'll provide an endpoint URL), and 3) any quantized FP16/INT8 variants Redwood recommends.
- Acceptance criteria: we'll validate latency and throughput but also want a small human-review on a 200-sample clinical set. Can Redwood provide the scoring template you plan to use?
- Procurement will need a short cost estimate for a 30-day pilot (expected peak RTPS and storage assumptions). I'll loop procurement on the dataset upload and SOW questions.

Attaching sample_data.zip to this reply (large; if you prefer S3 we can share a presigned link). Also please include your security questionnaire so our InfoSec can triage (SOC2 evidence, VPC connectivity options).

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@apollohealth.ai>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery: trial readiness & success criteria for Apollo Health

Emma — perfect, thank you. Confirming next steps and operational details so we can start the bench without delay.

Bench harness (what we'll run)
1) Chat scenario: multi-turn session replay at average 4 turns, 95th percentile length ~750 tokens. Collect p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, failure rate, memory profile.
2) Single-turn generation: summary flow — 3 prompt templates, variable length (target 120-220 tokens).
3) Embeddings: bulk vectorization throughput and cost per 1M rows.

Metrics we will report
- Latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), throughput (reqs/sec), tokens/sec, GPU utilization, failure/error types.
- Estimated per-1k-token cost using your current baseline assumptions (we will show relative delta vs their baseline and a cloud endpoint).
- Qualitative failure classification and short sample set for human review (we will flag hallucinations/PII leakage).

Data & access
- Please upload sample_data.zip to the Drive folder you have edit access to or share a presigned S3 link.
- If any prompts contain PHI, please confirm anonymization; we'll sign any required DPA addendum if needed.

Timeline (tight)
- Dataset delivered by 9/9 -> bench kickoff 9/13 -> 5 business days of controlled runs -> draft report 9/22 -> sync to review on 9/24.

Deliverables
- Detailed benchmark report (CSV + annotated plots)
- Short recommendation memo: model variant(s) + quantization plan + canary traffic config
- Run artifact: harness config + run_instructions.md (for handoff to your infra team)

Sergio — can you own the bench runs? Aditya — please draft the pilot cost estimate for procurement (I put estimated peak RPS and storage assumptions in the HubSpot deal).

Call: Thu 9/9 10:00am PT works for me. I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Neha

Subject: Internal: Apollo Health bench kickoff checklist & owners (internal)

Team — internal-only note based on Emma's latest. Kicking off bench next week; owners and short checklist below. No external recipients on this thread.

Owners
- Bench lead: sergio_alvarez (you own harness + run config)
- Cost estimate & procurement liaison: aditya_rao (please draft 30-day pilot pricing + assumptions)
- AE / customer comms: neha_kapoor (I'll coordinate scheduling & procurement questions)

Checklist (minimum)
- Validate sample_data.zip contents; ensure PHI/anonymization flag.
- Prepare 3 scenario configs (chat, single-turn, embeddings) and basic load profile.
- Select model candidates: r-instruct-1 / r-instruct-1-quant (FP16) / r-instruct-1-int8 (quant). Include a cloud endpoint baseline (customer-provided).
- Run baseline run against vLLM/TGI replay (we'll ask customer for log replay) and Redwood-hosted variants.
- Collate metrics: latency p50/p95/p99, throughput, tokens/sec, oom/failure reasons, cost per 1k tokens.
- Prepare quick human-eval template (200 samples) and redwood-evals run instructions.
- Draft report template (CSV, plots, short recommendations).

Attachments: run_instructions.md (text, 3KB) — I'll drop the run details here for you both.

Sergio — let's sync for 30 minutes after the 10:00am PT customer call to confirm the harness parameters.

Thanks,
Neha
